runtimeUiFollowupNotes: Image-practice dialog minimum scrolling-body track changes from min(4.5rem,24dvh) to min(4rem,24dvh); navigation controls retain room inside their scroll clip at enlarged text sizes.

SettingsDialog schedules focus return after an auto-saving Select closes while its trigger is disabled. The native newWordsPaused checkbox records return intent before saving only when that input actually has focus, preserving keyboard focus after re-enabling without forcing focus for pointer input that did not focus it. Pending return is cancelled on another control focus, pointer interaction, dialog closure or cleanup, and requires an enabled, connected control in the open dialog.

LevelSelect and AiModelSettings receive optional triggerRef/onCloseAutoFocus props; only the settings surface supplies this behavior. Shared Select, native checkbox structure, saved values, save handlers, disabled/locked conditions, history and AI request code are not changed by this follow-up.
The other six follow-up files are the icon QA workflow and QA scripts/helper. This inventory records source changes without asserting their test results.
